title: PlanGraph escalation judgment
description: The one genuinely new versioned record ADR 0007 / CC-08 adds: an EscalationJudge's return value for one escalated review finding. Everything else the escalation packet carries reuses existing protocols (the review-ledger finding record and plan-graph-block-escalation/1) rather than minting a second schema.

verdict.description: confirm routes the finding to its resolved owner (injecting into a queued node's obligations, or unsealing a completed one); reject writes the finding back to the escalating node's own obligations with the rationale in outcome_reason.

rationale.description: Carried into outcome_reason on reject, and into the confirmed obligation record's outcome_reason on confirm.
